title: Short: They robbed the Louvre in 7 minutes (Louvre jewel heist 2025)

lines.text: Seven minutes. That's all it took to rob the Louvre.
In October twenty twenty-five, a truck with a ladder lift parked right below a window.
Two men in work vests rode it up and cut through the glass.
Inside, they grabbed eight pieces of the French crown jewels.
Worth about one hundred million dollars.
On the way out, they dropped a crown with over a thousand diamonds.
Four suspects were arrested. But one year later, the jewels are still missing.
Where do you think they are?
